The Deployment Wizard: turns a metro OptimizationResult into an executable DeploymentPlan — Cloud Routers, provider connections, inter-metro backbone links, and routing protocols, with bandwidth-aware profile selection and honestly-reconciled pricing.

    Class
    Description
    DeploymentOutcome
    The result of executing a deployment plan.
    DeploymentPlan
    A complete deployment plan generated by the Deployment Wizard.
    ExecutionInputs
    The customer-supplied, per-connection authorization a DeploymentPlan.execute(ExecutionInputs) run needs to provision cloud provider connections: the cloud-specific authentication key, the DOT1Q VLAN tag, and (for Azure ExpressRoute) the peering type.
    PlannedCloudRouter
    A Cloud Router (FCR) to be created as part of a deployment plan.
    PlannedConnection
    A Fabric connection to be created as part of a deployment plan.
    PlanValueAssessment
    Fluent builder, returned by DeploymentPlan.valueRealization(), that computes the egress savings a deployment plan unlocks once the caller declares their per-provider monthly egress volumes.
    PlanValueRealization
    The value-realization view of a DeploymentPlan: the monthly cloud-egress saving the plan's private interconnects unlock (versus public-internet egress), netted against the plan's actual Equinix interconnect cost.
    ProvisioningError
    An error recorded while executing a deployment plan — a resource that could not be provisioned, a pre-flight or waiter observation, or a rollback deletion that failed.
